Basic reranking of documents against a query

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.rerankRequestFromJson("{\"documents\":[\"Machine learning is a subset of AI.\",\"The weather is sunny today.\",\"Deep learning uses neural networks.\"],\"model\":\"rerank-v3.5\",\"query\":\"What is machine learning?\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.rerank(_req)
debugPrint(result.results())
debugPrint(result.results()[0].relevanceScore())
```
